packageRules.description: Python stays below 3.15. config/secrets_parser.py imports yaml and requirements.txt pins PyYAML 6.0.3, the latest release, which ships no cp315 wheel (yaml/pyyaml#981 and #994, open on 2026-11-01), so the 3.15 bump in #29 failed the test job at install. Remove this rule once PyYAML publishes cp315 wheels.
